lines.speaker: Early Adopter
lines.text: You're the only one I can rely on.

lines.speaker: Early Adopter
lines.text: I've been scrambling from one hiding place to the next for 30 minutes now.

lines.speaker: Early Adopter
lines.text: I practically rubbed shoulders with an alien just a moment ago.

lines.speaker: Early Adopter
lines.text: Can't you take me in for just one day? Pleeeaaaasssee?
